versions.changelog:
- Added explicit "fresh eyes" self-review step in the Simplify pass, requiring re-reading all added/modified code for bugs, errors, and brittle logic before edits.
- Clarified the skill’s philosophy: emphasizes disciplined, fresh review using peak context before any further coding steps.
- No changes to code or functionality; documentation improvement only.
- No functional or interface changes. Safe for all users.

Initial release of the "simplify-and-harden" skill for coding agents.

- Provides an automated post-completion review (simplification, hardening, and micro-documentation) for non-trivial code changes.
- Runs only on substantive code diffs, skipping docs, configs, generated files, or tests-only changes.
- Restricts scope to code modified in the current task with strict budget and time limits.
- Two-pass process: first simplifies for clarity and removes noise, then hardens against security and resilience gaps.
- Cosmetic fixes auto-applied; refactors require explicit human approval via interactive prompts.
- Designed to complement—*not* replace—independent review before merging.
